name: To Be With Him
source:
To Be With Him is a short, semi-autobiographical, non-interactive visual novel about overcoming loss and letting go after a break-up.  

[From [url=https://isabow.itch.io/to-be-with-him]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《与他在一起》是一部短篇、半自传体、非互动的视觉小说，讲述了分手后克服失落和放手的故事。

[来自[url=https://isabow.itch.io/to-be-with-him]Itch.io[/url]]
